title: Close out xte: retro, then flesh out the next feasible epic
description:
Run the epic-close retro, verifying the code against xte's acceptance outside-in. Then pick the next feasible epic in soft order, read its rough scope and partition it into child ticks including its own EPIC-SKELETON pair.

Specific to this epic: mn7 (delete the TypeScript reconciler) is gated on xte precisely so that sandbox-executor.ts is not deleted out from under its new HTTP caller. Confirm that caller exists and is exercised before reporting xte done, because mn7 becomes safe to run on the strength of this close-out.
notes: 2026-09-23 11:23 - ticfac run epic-xte: attempt 20 reported a finding drafted for triage — proposed-tick "xte W1: register cloudflare-sandbox in the CLI's honoured executors and decide collect/cancel/dispose" (key 5471176ff732d0b1c4dfd78b0149c1345b1900612a71d7acbcd299275fc38b29, severity high, for this repository). Triage with `ticfac finding xte 5471176ff732d0b1c4dfd78b0149c1345b1900612a71d7acbcd299275fc38b29 --promote-as <tick> --by "<who>"`, `--discard --by "<who>"`, or — when it was repaired inside this epic — `--fixed-as <commit> --by "<who>"`; the tick closes and the finding rides to the close-out, which does not hand over while it is untriaged.
acceptance_criteria: The retro verifies xte's definition of done item by item against the code, sandbox-executor.ts is confirmed to have a live caller, and the next feasible epic has child ticks and a skeleton
